Body.Content:
What and why

We are refreshing the Analytics & Reports experience in the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal with an updated design and simplified navigation. New Room analytics and Desk analytics navigation options will make it easier for admins to access workplace data and insights to help optimize spaces, improve operations, and make informed decisions.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in early December 2026 and is expected to complete by late January 2027.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Admins using the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal

What will happen

  • The Analytics & Reports experience will receive a refreshed design and simplified navigation.
  • New Room analytics and Desk analytics entry points will appear in the left navigation.
  • Existing reports will move to their respective Room analytics or Desk analytics pages.
  • Recommended Actions will be renamed to Recommendations.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required. Admins can begin using the refreshed experience in the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal when it becomes available.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
